posts.title: Foundation is poured
posts.body:
The pour went in over two days with a crew of six. Rebar was tied on site and inspected before the concrete arrived.

Next up is block work for the walls and columns. That phase is the one we are raising money for now.

posts.title: Both septic tanks are finished
posts.body: Two tanks, each ten feet deep, dug by hand and lined. Sanitation is the piece people skip, and it is the piece that decides whether a house is livable in ten years.
